create_LaikagoPose_default: create a LaikagoPose instance with all default zero motor angles for the quadruped robot
create_LaikagoPose_custom: create a LaikagoPose instance with custom abduction hip and knee angles for each of the four legs
review_LaikagoPose_class: review the LaikagoPose attrs class that stores 12 motor angle attributes for a quadruped robot
summarize_LaikagoPose_attributes: summarize the LaikagoPose class attributes representing abduction hip and knee angles for legs 0 through 3
inspect_default_constants: inspect the LAIKAGO_DEFAULT_ABDUCTION_ANGLE LAIKAGO_DEFAULT_HIP_ANGLE and LAIKAGO_DEFAULT_KNEE_ANGLE module constants
